profile.headline: Software Engineer | Agentic Engineering | Backend, Data & Distributed Systems | Full-Stack | Java, AWS, OpenSearch, GraphQL
profile.summary:
I’m a Software Engineer focused on building backend, data, and distributed systems, with full-stack experience delivering end-to-end products.
 
At The Walt Disney Company, I work on the search platform, building and maintaining systems that power content discovery across brands like ABC News, ESPN, Disney, Marvel, and National Geographic.
 
I have experience designing and operating event-driven architectures and microservices, using technologies like Java, AWS, GraphQL, React, and OpenSearch to build scalable, production-grade systems.
 
Previously at Cvent, I shipped full-stack features used by thousands of live attendees, working across frontend applications and backend services to deliver reliable, user-facing functionality.
 
Recently, I’ve been exploring agentic engineering and applying it to side projects, building systems that combine structured data with LLMs to generate actionable insights, automate workflows, and support better decision-making.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
• Build and maintain backend services for the search platform, powering content discovery across major brands including ABC News, ESPN, Disney, Marvel, and National Geographic

• Develop and support distributed, event-driven systems integrated with OpenSearch to enable scalable, high-performance search

• Design and maintain APIs and data pipelines for indexing and retrieving large volumes of content across services

• Work within AWS-based infrastructure to ensure reliability, scalability, and low-latency performance
positions.insights: Java, Amazon Web Services (AWS) and +9 skills

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
• Designed and shipped full-stack features used by thousands of event attendees, across React frontends and Java-based backend microservices

• Led development of a profile image integration for the chat platform, building a background sync system with a third-party provider while maintaining existing system stability

• Developed and maintained microservices and APIs supporting real-time chat and attendee interactions

• Delivered features end-to-end, from concept through production, working across multiple systems and handling ambiguous requirements

positions.title: Software Engineer I
positions.description:
• Built and delivered full-stack features across web applications, contributing to improved user experience for event attendees

• Developed scalable frontend and backend components using React and Java-based services

• Contributed to the design and implementation of new features, focusing on performance, maintainability, and system reliability

positions.title: Software Developer (co-op)
positions.description: Developed a robust WebRTC streaming app supporting 1000+ streams per live event, leveraging scalable backend technologies and an in-house SDK. Gained expertise in backend frameworks, media servers, and gateway clusters to create scalable streaming applications.
